entries.english: Swahili Daytime & Prayer-Time Reckoning (12-Hour Cycle from 6 a.m.)
entries.translation: Alfajiri (dawn, ~4:30–5:30 a.m.) → Asubuhi (morning, 6 a.m. = saa kumi na mbili) → Adhuhuri (noon, 12 p.m. = saa sita) → Alasiri (afternoon, ~3:30 p.m.) → Jioni (late afternoon) → Magharibi (sunset, 6 p.m. = saa kumi na mbili) → Esha (nightfall, ~7:30 p.m.)
entries.pronunciation: ahl-fah-jee-ree • ah-soo-boo-hee • ah-dhoo-hoo-ree • ah-lah-see-ree • jee-oh-nee • mah-ghah-ree-bee • eh-shah
entries.context: A. C. Madan (1902, p. 181 s.v. Hour & p. 410 s.v. Time): Swahili hours (saa) count from 6:00 a.m. (sunrise) and 6:00 p.m. (sunset), so 7:00 a.m. is saa moja ya asubuhi and noon is saa sita
